name: CoinLobster Crypto Data API
description: Real-time crypto whale tracker: live whale trades, whale alerts and smart money across 18 exchanges, plus on-chain DEX swaps, market data, scored trading signals and DeFi analytics. Everything runs on credits (10-50 per call): buy credit packs pay-per-request, or subscribe monthly for a cheaper credit allowance that refills each billing cycle (unused allowance does not roll over; packs never expire). Commercial use allowed on every paid plan. POST /register with your email to create a key and purchase credits or a plan via Stripe. Free, no-key endpoints and the MCP server (/mcp) are documented under the "free" tag. See /llms.txt for an LLM-readable overview.
